summary: Iteration 21 — Admin /dealers collapsible pattern (dealers.tsx) tested end-to-end at 1440x900 as admin@fourbuy.co.za. RESULT: 5 of 6 requested checks PASS, 1 CRITICAL BUG confirmed. (1) COLLAPSED BY DEFAULT — PASS. On first render 14 dealership group headers show but 0 dealer-card-* rows are in the DOM. (2) HEADER TAP TOGGLES — PASS. Tapping group-<id> expands to reveal that group's users (dealer-card count 0 -> 1 for Colour Test Motors); tapping again collapses back to 0. Chevron visually flips from chevron-forward (>) to chevron-down (v) as seen in the screenshots (Ionicons font glyphs don't expose data-icon on web so SVG-string check returned empty, but visual confirmation is unambiguous). (3) group-add-user-<id> ICON — PASS. Icon is only present on non-solo/non-legacy dealerships (all 14 seeded dealerships are real, so the legacy-hide branch could not be exercised with live data, but code is correct — see dealers.tsx:626-634 `{!isSolo ? ... : null}`). Clicking group-add-user-<id> opens the invite modal pre-populated with the dealership name ('ADD USER TO COLOUR TEST MOTORS' modal title verified). Closing the invite modal does NOT auto-expand the parent group (cards still 0 after close). (4) group-add-user does NOT propagate to header expand — PASS (child TouchableOpacity correctly stops bubbling in react-native-web). (5) REGRESSION per-row buttons when group expanded — PASS. For user 562259fa in Colour Test Motors: dealer-add-teammate-<uid>, dealer-edit-<uid>, dealer-reset-pw-<uid>, dealer-active-toggle-<uid>, remove-dealer-<uid> all present and interactive. Clicking dealer-add-teammate opens the invite modal; clicking dealer-edit opens the EditDealerModal (edit-dealer-close visible); modals close cleanly. (6) CRITICAL BUG — MASTER SWITCH TAP ALSO EXPANDS THE GROUP. Repro on Ford Bryanston (dealership 5b5cd0c6-3f06-45c4-8067-52c40f0c92bf): starting collapsed, one precise mouse-click on group-toggle-<id> (bbox 1367,346, 40x20) causes both (a) the dealership to flip ACTIVE->DISABLED (correct — cascade to both users worked: header sub 'X suspended' went 1 -> 3, individual user rows carry SUSPENDED pill) and (b) the group to EXPAND, revealing Johann Linsky + Zelda Visagie under the header (bug). Screenshot /tmp/bug_switch_expands.png shows both states in the same frame. The review request explicitly states 'the switch should toggle it without accidentally expanding the group (Switch swallows the parent Touchable press)' — this holds on native iOS/Android where <Switch> is a native component, but on react-native-web <Switch> renders as a plain <div role='switch'> (see outerHTML captured: `<div class="css-view-g5y9jx ..." data-testid="group-toggle-..." style="height: 20px; width: 40px;">...`) and does NOT stopPropagation, so the click bubbles up to the wrapping <TouchableOpacity onPress={toggleExpanded}> at dealers.tsx:606-611 and fires the toggle. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

action_items: Fix master-switch propagation: on react-native-web the <Switch> child does not stop the click from bubbling to the wrapping <TouchableOpacity onPress={toggleExpanded}>. Two simple options: (a) Convert the outer TouchableOpacity into a plain <View> and wrap ONLY the chevron+text block (the left half of the header) in its own inner TouchableOpacity — leaving the right-side groupToggleWrap outside the expand-tap zone. (b) Wrap the groupToggleWrap <View> with `onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}` and `onTouchEnd={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` (or `onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` for web) so its taps don't bubble. Option (a) is the cleaner React Native pattern.
The group-add-user-<id> icon does NOT exhibit this bug (child TouchableOpacity DOES stop propagation in rn-web), so it can stay. Only the Switch needs the fix.

Optional: verify the same fix keeps the legacy 'solo' branch (isSolo === true) working — for those the Switch is disabled=true but still rendered, and no bug in that case since a disabled Switch also has no press-through concern.
critical_code_review_comments: dealers.tsx:606-647 — The entire section header (chevron + name + groupToggleWrap containing the Add-User icon AND the Switch) is a single <TouchableOpacity onPress>. On native, <Switch> intercepts touches; on rn-web, it does not. This is a portability bug baked into the layout.

dealers.tsx:625-646 — groupToggleWrap layout could be pulled out and rendered as a sibling to the toggle-touchable region rather than a descendant, which would fix the bubbling issue architecturally rather than via stopPropagation hacks.
dealers.tsx:594 — `data: expandedGroups[g.dealership_id] ? g.users : []` correctly hides users when collapsed — this piece is right; the bug is only in the header tap dispatch.
dealers.tsx:602 — activeUsers count is correct but the sub-line renders `N users` even when N === 0 (impossible with current grouping since a group is only created for existing users, so acceptable).

dealers.tsx:505 — per-row Add User uses `item.dealership_id ?? item.id` as fallback for legacy (no dealership_id) users. Note this passes a user id to /api/admin/dealerships/{id}/users which would 404 — acceptable since legacy dealers should re-login to auto-migrate first, but consider disabling the button when dealership_id is null instead of silently 404ing.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In react-native-web, the <Switch> component renders as a plain <div role='switch'> (verified via outerHTML capture: `<div class="css-view-g5y9jx r-cursor-1loqt21 r-userSelect-lrvibr" data-testid="group-toggle-..." style="height: 20px; width: 40px;">...`). It does NOT call stopPropagation on its click/touch events. The section header at dealers.tsx:606-611 is a <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setExpandedGroups(...)}> that wraps the ENTIRE header including the groupToggleWrap <View> which contains the Switch. When the user clicks the Switch on web, the click bubbles up to the parent TouchableOpacity and BOTH handlers fire: (1) Switch.onValueChange -> toggleDealershipActive succeeds (verified — Ford Bryanston flipped to DISABLED and both users are SUSPENDED); (2) TouchableOpacity.onPress -> expanded[gid] flips true (bug — group visibly expands). The behavior described in the review request ('Switch swallows the parent Touchable press') is only true on native iOS/Android where <Switch> is bridged to UISwitch/SwitchCompat which absorb touches. MITIGATION: refactor the header so only the left content (chevron + title) is inside the toggle-TouchableOpacity, and render groupToggleWrap as a sibling <View> outside — or add `onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` (web) / `onStartShouldSetResponder` (native) to the groupToggleWrap <View>.
